missed_dose.value:
FDA Label (PRADAXA): If a dose is not taken at the scheduled time, take it as soon as possible on the same day; skip the missed dose if it cannot be taken at least 6 hours before the next scheduled dose. Do not double the dose to make up for a missed dose.

EHRA 2021 Practical Guide (BID Regimen):
• Missed dose: Take the forgotten full dose up until 6 hours after the scheduled intake (half of the 12-hour dosing interval). After 6 hours, skip the missed dose and take the next scheduled dose.
• Double dose: Skip the next planned dose (after 12 hours) and restart the regular BID dosing regimen 24 hours after the double dose intake.
• Uncertainty about dose intake: Do not take another capsule; continue with the regular BID regimen starting with the next dose at the 12-hour interval.
• Administration reminder: Swallow capsules whole (do NOT open/crush — bioavailability increases +75%).
• Acute overdose (≤ 2 hours, no bleeding): Consider activated charcoal (30–50 g in adults) to reduce absorption.

refs.quote: If a dose of dabigatran etexilate capsules are not taken at the scheduled time, the dose should be taken as soon as possible on the same day; the missed dose should be skipped if it cannot be taken at least 6 hours before the next scheduled dose. The dose of dabigatran etexilate capsules should not be doubled to make up for a missed dose.

refs.quote: for NOACs with a twice daily (BID) dosing regimen (i.e., intake every 12h), a forgotten full dose can be taken up until 6 h after the scheduled intake.
For NOACs with a BID dosing regimen, the next planned dose (i.e. after 12 h) may be skipped, with the regular BID dosing regimen restarted 24h after the double dose intake.
For NOACs with a BID dosing regimen, it is generally advisable to not take another tablet/capsule, but to continue with the regular dose regimen, i.e. starting with the next dose at the 12h interval.
